extDescription.message: Two subtitle lines at once on Netflix and Jellyfin, with a transcript, line replay, auto-pause and optional local translation.

actionOn.message: Subpair is on (click to turn off)

actionOff.message: Subpair is off (click to turn on)

badgeOff.description: Toolbar badge while off; at most 4 characters.

noticeOffTitle.message: Turn Subpair back on (also the Subpair toolbar button, or Alt+Shift+S unless you changed it)

noticeAskTitle.message: Subpair will read this Jellyfin server's subtitles and may send them to your translator. Click to allow this server.

noticeSetupTitle.message: Open the Subpair settings to choose the main and second subtitle language

btnPanel.message: Show or hide the transcript panel

withKeys.description: A button name and its keyboard keys, e.g. Previous line (A).

profileGone.message: this profile no longer exists, choose one in the settings

pictureAboveBar.message: Where the picture sits above the bar:

backgroundNote.message: Applies to text on the video. The bottom bar has its own look.

wantedMissing.message: $1 is wanted but not showing: $2. Choose it again to retry.

noTrackNoTranslator.message: no track in this video and no translator for it

translateInstead.message: Translate from the main line instead

translateInsteadNote.message: for a bad or out-of-sync track

automaticFirstReady.message: Automatic (the first one that is ready)

placeSummaryOverlay.message: On the video, $1 px from the picture

backendEztrans.message: ezTrans (local, Windows, Japanese to Korean only)

backendClaude.message: Claude (claude -p, uses your Claude Code login)

backendApi.message: Anthropic API (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for the bridge)

backendOpenai.message: OpenAI-compatible (OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama...; address in bridge/config.json)

modelHintClaude.message: haiku, sonnet, opus or a full model id

modelHintApi.message: a model id, such as claude-haiku-5-5

modelHintOpenai.message: a model id your provider offers

trBridgeDown.message: translation bridge is not running (npm run bridge)

trNoneReady.message: no translator is ready for $1 to $2

trCannot.message: $1 cannot translate $2 to $3 (or is not set up)

trSavedPartial.message: Saved $1 translation only fits $2 of $3 lines, translating the rest

trLost.message: Lost contact with the translation bridge

trNotLoaded.message: Translation finished but could not be loaded

saveNewOldKept.message: Saved the new translation to Jellyfin; the old one could not be removed (status $1, needs an administrator)

saveKeptForeign.message: Kept the subtitle that is on Jellyfin: Subpair did not make it

saveNoPermission.message: Could not save to Jellyfin: this account is not allowed to manage subtitles

saveStoppedReload.message: Stopped saving: the extension was reloaded

optFirstRun.message: Welcome. Choose the language of the main line (the subtitles you read along with, for example the language you are learning) and of the second line (your own language), then press Save settings.

optChangedElsewhere.message: These settings were changed in the player while this page was open. Saving now replaces those changes.

optLanguagesHint.message: Pick a first choice and, if you like, fallbacks. The first language that has a subtitle track in the video is used.

optSecondLineHint.message: (a track in this language, or a translation of the main line)

optTranslationHint.message: When a Netflix or Jellyfin title has no track in your first second-line language, the main line is translated by a small local program (the bridge, started with npm run bridge in the Subpair folder). Translations are saved per title and reused next time. If the bridge is off, the next second-line language that exists is used instead.

optWhenAuto.message: Automatic (ezTrans a few lines ahead, the others the whole title first)

optWhenLive.message: Live, a few lines ahead of the video

optModelsHint.message: Model for each translator. Empty uses the bridge's own setting (shown in grey when the bridge is running). API keys and the OpenAI-compatible address stay in the bridge's bridge/config.json, never in the browser.

optBackground.message: Background behind text on the video

optAlignHint.message: (bottom bar only: where the picture sits above it)

optJoinLines.message: Show each subtitle on one line (join the line breaks the subtitle file puts inside a cue)

optHideSpeaker.message: Hide speaker names at the start of a line, like （田中） or (Alice)

optPanelTimes.message: Show timestamps in the transcript panel

optPanel.message: Show the transcript panel on the right (normal view; in fullscreen it has its own on/off, starting off)

optAutoPause.message: Auto-pause at the end of every main line

optColorsHint.message: Colors words by part of speech. Japanese only for now (needs the Japanese analyzer). Click a word to copy it, Ctrl+click for its dictionary form, Alt+click for the whole line.

optColorize.message: Color words by part of speech

optShortcutsHint.message: Click a box and press a key to add it; Backspace removes the last one. Keys pressed with Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Cmd are left to the page. Turning Subpair on and off has its own shortcut (Alt+Shift+S): change it in the browser's extension shortcut settings.

optServersHint.message: Subpair works on a Jellyfin server only after you allow it (the "Use Subpair on this server?" button in the player). These are the servers you allowed.

optBackupHint.message: Settings are saved with the Save button at the top.

optLocalOnly.message: too big for sync, saved on this browser only

optNoMain.message: choose a main language, nothing is shown until then

optBadBridge.message: the bridge address must be http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost, reset to the default

optBadModel.message: "$1" is not a model name, the $2 model was cleared

optImportConfirm.message: Replace all $1 profile(s) with the $2 in this file?

bridgeErr_body_not_json.message: body must be a JSON object

bridgeErr_bad_language.message: $1 must be a language code such as ja or ko

bridgeErr_bad_model.message: model must be 1 to 100 letters, digits or . : / - _

bridgeErr_bad_key.message: key must be 1 to $1 letters, digits, - or _

bridgeErr_bad_texts.message: $1 must be an array of at most $2 strings of at most $3 characters

bridgeErr_bad_cues.message: cues must be an array of 1 to $1 cues

bridgeErr_bad_cue.message: each cue needs text (a string) and numeric start and end seconds, start <= end

bridgeErr_same_language.message: source and target language are the same

bridgeErr_needs_model.message: $1 needs a model: send one with the request or set $1.model in bridge/config.json

bridgeErr_eztrans_not_configured.message: ezTrans XP was not found: set eztrans.dir in bridge/config.json to the ezTrans XP folder (Windows only)

bridgeErr_claude_missing.message: the claude command did not run (install Claude Code and log in, or set claude.command in bridge/config.json)

bridgeErr_api_key_missing.message: no Anthropic API key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or bridge/config.json api.key)

bridgeErr_openai_not_configured.message: OpenAI-compatible backend is not set up (openai.baseUrl and, for hosted services, OPENAI_API_KEY or openai.key in bridge/config.json)

bridgeErr_too_many_requests.message: too many translations in progress, try again shortly

bridgeErr_too_many_jobs.message: $1 titles are already being translated, try again later

bridgeErr_job_running.message: this title is already being translated with this backend and model; try again when it is done

bridgeErr_lines_failed.message: $1 lines could not be translated; the saved translation was kept

bridgeErr_refused.message: $1: Anthropic API declined to translate this part

bridgeErr_refused_for.message: $1: Anthropic API declined to translate this part ($2)

bridgeErr_max_tokens.message: $1: Anthropic API reply hit max_tokens ($2); raise api.maxTokens or lower api.batch

bridgeErr_no_content.message: $1: OpenAI-compatible API: no message content in the reply

bridgeErr_cmd_unsafe.message: $1: cannot run $2 safely through cmd.exe (argument $3); use the .exe installer or point the command at an .exe

bridgeErr_eztrans_no_pipe.message: $1: eztrans helper did not open its pipe

bridgeErr_eztrans_timeout.message: $1: eztrans did not answer in time

bridgeErr_eztrans_bad_reply.message: $1: eztrans sent a reply length of $2

bridgeBadUrl.message: the bridge address or route is not allowed

bridgeTimedOut.message: the bridge did not answer within $1 ms

noWorkerAnswer.message: no answer from the extension worker

seasonTranslateNote.message: one episode after another, saved for later

seasonStarted.message: Translating the whole season in the background

nextQueued.message: Translating the next episode in the background
